description: Cached covalent thia-Michael (cysteine-warhead model) per-species energies, used by the notebook so the covalent example displays without the heavy geometry/HF dependencies. The notebook reads this file rather than hardcoding the numbers in a cell. Regenerate with the companion scripts: thia_michael.py (local FCI and VQE per species) and sv1_covalent.py (Amazon Braket SV1 evaluation). The sulfur-containing species require RDKit, PySCF, and basis-set-exchange.
method: CAS(4,4) / 8 qubits per species, STO-3G; FCI by exact diagonalization, VQE by AllSinglesDoubles
notes: The covalent binding energy is exothermic (a covalent bond forms), consistent with experimental thia-Michael additions. VQE reproduces the exact active-space FCI energy to better than 0.02 mHa for every species, so the VQE and FCI binding energies agree to about 0.01 kcal/mol. Absolute values are at the STO-3G / CAS(4,4) level: illustrative, not converged to chemical accuracy.
